metadata.description:
This POAP was distributed directly via printed claim sheets to participants in the 2023 Things 4 Good Candle Fundraiser hosted by the Thingelstad family. This annual give back event raised donations causes that we want to support by selling handmade wooden wick candles.

This year we created 204 candles in eight different scents: Winter Wonderland, Apple of My Eye, Tea Time, Oh My Darling, True North, Pumpkin Pie, Old Fashioned, and Plain Jane.

We provide the materials and make the candles so that ALL proceeds from the fundraiser go to four different non-profits that we each pick. This year we supported:

- Oceanites → https://www.oceanites.org
- Food Recovery Network → https://www.foodrecoverynetwork.org
- Heart to Care Tanzania → https://www.hearttocaretanzania.org
- American Prairie → https://americanprairie.org
metadata.name: Things 4 Good 2023 Candle Fundraiser
